verified_facts.text: The hotel is on the Suhe Creek waterfront and forms part of the SUHE CREEK project, a riverside urban revitalization.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the Suhe Creek waterfront, Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai forms part of the SUHE CREEK project, a riverside urban revitalization comprising residential, retail and art spaces, as well as parks.

verified_facts.text: The property combines a 48-storey tower with the restored former Chamber of Commerce Shanghai building dating from 1916.
verified_facts.excerpt: the property combines a 48-storey tower with the majestically restored former Chamber of Commerce Shanghai building dating from 1916, surrounded by lush gardens.

verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito was awarded one Michelin star by The Michelin Guide Shanghai for 6 consecutive years since 2019.

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Bar's oval counter in Shanghai is made from hand-hammered bronze topped with mirrored steel.

verified_facts.text: At sunset hours, every drink ordered at The Bvlgari Bar is paired with fresh canapes, at the oval bar or on the outdoor terrace.

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Bar shares the 47th floor with Il Ristorante - Niko Romito.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sharing the 47th floor with Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, The Bvlgari Bar shimmers like a jewel against the panoramic backdrop of the Bund riverfront and Pudong skyline.

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Spa uses La Mer products and offers rituals inspired by traditional Chinese medicine.
